title: Apple Built a Quantum-Proof Way to Prove a Photo Is Real. Here Is How It Works
excerpt: Apple introduced Apple Reference Image, an opt-in mode on the iPhone 18 Pro that cryptographically signs raw pixel data at the sensor, before the operating system can touch it. It is a harder answer to the deepfake question than C2PA, and it is about to reshape what proof a photograph can carry.

title: Getty Is Going Private Through Bankruptcy. Here Is What Photographers Should Do Now
excerpt: Getty Images announced a prepackaged Chapter 11 restructuring that would take the company private, backed by up to $533 million in new equity. Getty says there is no anticipated impact on contributors, but nothing is court-approved yet, and photographers who earn from stock should document what they are owed starting now.

title: The Gas Station You Drive Past Every Day Is a Photograph Waiting for Night
excerpt: Fstoppers argues daylight documents a place while night light transforms it, and that darkness is the best background remover a photographer has. Expose for the highlights, set the white balance by hand, and scout without the camera.
